mcpb-manifest-v0.3.schema.json is Anthropic's published JSON Schema for the
manifest.json of an MCP Bundle (.mcpb, formerly the Desktop Extension .dxt),
manifest_version 0.3, copied verbatim on 2026-11-21 from
https://github.com/anthropics/mcpb (schemas/mcpb-manifest-v0.3.schema.json,
main branch). The specification's prose is MANIFEST.md in the same
repository; the install steps are Claude's help article "Getting started
with Local MCP servers on Claude Desktop" (support.claude.com).
The repository's licence: Apache-2.0 for new contributions, MIT for older
ones (its LICENSE file); both fit this project's MIT OR Apache-2.0. It is
a test fixture only and is not shipped.
